method.scope: Independent anonymous visible-output review. No plans, prompts, mappings, generation history or peer reports consulted.
method.copy_method: Direct readings from supplied width-720 pixels, followed by line-by-line matching. Raw briefs were already known from preparation; this is not a memory-free transcription test.
method.punctuation_limit: Spaces around middle dots and dash lengths are pixel observations, not Unicode-byte proof.
method.scores: Integer 1–5 for all seven dimensions; no aggregate score or averaging.
method.ratio_method: Supplied native width/height checked against supplied target, with 1% relative tolerance; all are within tolerance.
method.art_direction_limit: Only supplied review-protocol.md was authorized; its linked art-direction.md was not opened. AI-slop scores use the seven-dimension rubric and located finish evidence, without authorship inference.
